details.fitTitle: This project will be right for you when:
fitItems: You are opening a restaurant, café, hotel, shop, office or service venue and want to create a space tailored to your brand's character.
You are choosing or adapting premises and want to plan their function well before the fit-out begins.
You care about an interior that is not only beautiful but also functional and comfortable in everyday use – for both customers and your team.
You want to create a place that sets your brand apart and stays in customers' memory.
You are planning to refresh an existing venue or change its character without a full-scale rebuild.
You are looking for a partner who will guide you through the entire process end to end – from strategy and concept, through documentation, trade coordination and support during the fit-out.
You are planning to grow the brand and want solutions that can be consistently rolled out across future locations.

stages.title: Brief, research and strategy
stages.text: We get to know how your business works, your target group, the character of the brand and the goals the space is meant to achieve. We analyse the location, competition and inspirations to create an interior that supports the company's growth and builds a coherent customer experience.

stages.title: Site survey
stages.text: If the premises are already available, we carry out a detailed site survey and photographic documentation. This way every subsequent design decision is based on the real dimensions and conditions of the space.

stages.title: Functional layout
stages.text: We design a venue layout that matches the way the business operates. We analyse the flow of customers and staff, zone the space and optimise how it is used. In hospitality projects we consult the layout with a sanitary inspectorate (Sanepid) expert at an early stage, to reduce the risk of costly changes during the fit-out.

stages.title: Concept design
stages.text: The vision for the investment takes on real shape. We create a coherent interior concept that translates the brand's character into space – from mood and colour, through materials, lighting and furnishings, to the details that give the place its individual character. Visualisations, moodboards and a concept presentation let every key decision be verified before the fit-out begins. We choose durable solutions in line with the investment budget and the applicable technical and fire-safety requirements.

stages.title: Construction design
stages.text: We prepare a complete set of construction documentation that translates the concept into precise guidelines for delivery. It covers all the drawings and studies contractors need, along with cross-trade coordination – from services to approvals with sanitary (Sanepid) and fire-safety experts. For newly built premises we also work with the lead architect. This way the entire delivery process is better coordinated and the risk of costly on-site errors is reduced.

stages.title: Specifications and quotes
stages.text: We prepare detailed specifications of materials, ready-made furnishings and bespoke, made-to-order elements. We also help obtain quotes from trusted contractors, manufacturers and craftspeople, which makes it easier to plan the investment budget.

stages.title: Author's supervision
stages.text: During the fit-out we make sure the work is carried out in line with the design and help resolve day-to-day issues that arise on site. This minimises the risk of errors and supports the smooth progress of the investment. We agree the scope of supervision individually, depending on the needs of the project.

faqItems.q: When is the best time to approach a commercial interior architect?
faqItems.a: Ideally before signing the lease or buying the premises. This lets us assess the potential of the space, verify what is possible and avoid costly decisions at later stages of the investment.

faqItems.q: How much does the design of a restaurant, hotel or shop interior cost?
faqItems.a: We price every project individually, because each investment has its own specifics and scope. The cost depends on factors such as the type of venue, its floor area, the level of complexity and the expected scope of the work. Already after the first conversation we can outline the scope of work, propose a suitable model of cooperation and prepare an approximate quote.

faqItems.q: How long does a commercial interior project take?
faqItems.a: The time depends on the size and complexity of the investment. We set the schedule individually, taking into account the planned start of works and the venue's opening date. Designing a small café can take around 3 months, while for larger investments, such as hotels, the design process is run in stages and can take well over a year.

faqItems.q: What kinds of commercial interiors do you design?
faqItems.a: We design restaurants, cafés, bars, hotels, food halls, concept stores, fitness spaces, spa & wellness, boutiques, shops, offices and other service and commercial spaces. Every type of business has different functional and technical requirements, which is why we develop each project individually, taking into account the specifics of the business, the character of the brand and the needs of its users.

faqItems.q: Does a restaurant design require approvals from the sanitary inspectorate?
faqItems.a: Yes, if the nature of the investment calls for it. For venues that require approvals, we coordinate cooperation with the relevant specialists, including sanitary-hygiene and fire-safety experts, and factor their guidelines in already at the documentation stage. This helps reduce the risk of changes during the fit-out.

faqItems.q: Can the interior design also cover branding and visual identity?
faqItems.a: Absolutely. Depending on your needs, the project can be extended to include the brand's visual identity and communication elements, such as signage, a visual identity system, graphics, packaging or uniforms. We also work with graphic designers – we prepare the design assumptions and brief and make sure the branding and the interior develop in parallel, creating a coherent brand experience.

faqItems.q: Does the design take the assumed investment budget into account?
faqItems.a: Yes. The design is built around the assumed investment budget. Already at the concept stage we propose materials and solutions matched to its assumptions, and once the design work is complete we prepare detailed specifications of materials and furnishings that streamline pricing and delivery of the investment.

faqItems.q: Why is it worth hiring an interior architect for a restaurant, hotel or service venue?
faqItems.a: A well-prepared design lets you make the most important decisions before the fit-out begins. Whether we are designing a restaurant, café, hotel, shop or office, a well-planned space streamlines how the business operates, reduces the risk of costly changes during the fit-out and helps create a place consistent with the character of the brand and customers' expectations.

faqItems.q: Can an existing venue be refreshed without a full rebuild?
faqItems.a: Yes. Not every investment requires a full-scale rebuild. In many cases the interior can be refreshed by changing the materials, lighting, colours, furnishings or selected fit-out elements. We always define the scope of work individually after analysing the existing space and the business objectives.

faqItems.q: Do you design interiors with brand growth and a future chain of venues in mind?
faqItems.a: Yes. If you are planning to grow a chain of venues, we factor in the possibility of scaling the project from the very start. We design solutions that are easy to replicate and roll out across future locations, while keeping the individual character of each interior. This makes it possible to build a recognisable brand without compromising on quality and the fit to each specific space.

faqItems.q: Where do you deliver commercial interior projects?
faqItems.a: Although our studio is based in Wrocław, we design and supervise projects across Poland, including Warsaw, Kraków, Łódź and Gdańsk.

apartments.cta: Explore the offer for apartment interior design
apartments.projectDescription: We design premium apartments and flats, creating interiors tailored to the everyday life of their residents. We run every project in stages — from understanding your needs and the potential of the space, through building a coherent concept, to complete documentation that lets the build run smoothly. We consult on every stage and make the key decisions together, so that the finished interior responds to your lifestyle, needs and expectations. Every project is created individually, with care for ergonomics, materials and finishing details.
apartments.fitTitle: When is it worth commissioning an apartment interior design?
fitItems: You are taking over an apartment from a developer and want to make the most of its potential from the very start.
You are buying a secondary-market apartment and planning a comprehensive renovation.
The apartment's layout doesn't suit your needs and you want to make better use of the available space.
You want an interior designed individually, tailored to your lifestyle rather than assembled from off-the-shelf solutions.
You value high-quality materials, bespoke solutions and considered details.
You want to plan the investment budget consciously, before the finishing works begin.
You care about a smooth, stress-free process.

stages.title: Brief and needs analysis
stages.text: We get to know you, the way you live and what you expect from the space. We devote the first stage to a conversation about your needs, lifestyle, aesthetics, budget and the schedule of the investment. We want to understand not only how the interior should look, but above all how it should work day to day. At the start of our cooperation you also receive a detailed questionnaire that helps us gather all the important information and build a solid foundation for the design work that follows.

stages.title: Site survey
stages.text: Before we start designing, we get to know the space and its potential. We take precise measurements and check the spatial relationships and technical elements that affect the design. For apartments still under construction, we work from the technical documentation and materials provided by the developer, analysing the scope for changes and for tailoring the space individually.

stages.title: Functional layouts
stages.text: A well-designed interior always starts with function. We analyse the potential of the space and prepare at least two functional layout options, which we discuss together. We then refine the chosen solution to make the most of the apartment's potential and create a space that is comfortable in everyday use.

stages.title: Concept design
stages.text: We give the interior its character through form, materials and light. We select materials, colours, textures and lighting and design bespoke joinery and solutions. We present the concept as a detailed presentation with realistic visualisations, which we discuss together at a meeting. We work with real materials, so at this stage we also show initial colour and material samples. This stage includes two rounds of revisions, so that the final concept is fully refined and matches your expectations.

stages.title: Construction design
stages.text: We prepare complete construction documentation that forms the basis for the works. It covers all the technical drawings contractors need — from tile layouts, through services, to detailed designs for joinery and other made-to-order elements. This way the works run more smoothly and the risk of errors on site is reduced.

stages.title: Specifications and quotes
stages.text: We prepare specifications and shopping lists covering finishing materials, ready-made furniture, lighting and accessories, with specific products and where to buy them. We also support the budgeting process by gathering quotes from trusted contractors and suppliers.

stages.title: Author's supervision
stages.text: During the works we support both clients and contractors. As part of author's supervision we visit the site, check that the work is carried out in line with the design and help resolve questions and situations that call for a decision. During visits we discuss technical details with the contractors and, where needed, prepare additional explanations or drawings. We agree the scope and frequency of supervision individually, depending on the needs of the project.

benefits.title: A stress-free process
benefits.text: We bring order to the entire interior fit-out process. You don't have to coordinate dozens of decisions about materials, furnishings and technical solutions yourself — every element is thought through and described in the documentation. Thanks to author's supervision, we also help translate the design into the actual build and respond to situations that arise during the works.

benefits.title: Conscious decisions and budget control
benefits.text: The design lets you make all the key decisions and plan your spending before the works begin. This helps you avoid impulse purchases, costly changes and solutions that won't hold up in everyday use.

benefits.title: Bespoke solutions
benefits.text: We don't create interiors based on ready-made templates or passing trends. We tailor every solution to the residents' way of life, the character of the space and their individual needs. Bespoke joinery, considered functional layouts and a conscious choice of materials make every interior unique and timeless.

benefits.title: Consistency at every stage
benefits.text: One of the greatest advantages of comprehensive cooperation is the consistency of the whole process. From the first conversation, through concept and documentation, to the build stage, every decision stems from a single, considered vision.

apartments.seoHeading:
Apartment interior design —
Wrocław and all of Poland
apartments.seoText: We design apartments and flats primarily in Wrocław, but we also deliver projects in other cities. We work on new-build apartments from developers, premium flats and secondary-market properties alike, including apartments in townhouses that need remodelling or a complete renovation. We run every project comprehensively — from analysing residents' needs and the functional layout, through the concept and construction documentation, to supporting clients during the build.

faqItems.q: When is the best time to start working with an interior designer?
faqItems.a: Ideally before the finishing works or renovation begin. For new-build apartments it's worth getting in touch as early as the tenant-modification stage, so the functional layout can be adapted to the residents' needs and costly alterations at a later stage can be avoided. The earlier we start working together, the more the design can offer.

faqItems.q: How long does an apartment project take?
faqItems.a: The time needed to prepare the design depends on the size of the apartment, the scope of the work and how quickly the clients make decisions. We set the schedule individually at the start of our cooperation. We run the project in stages — from analysing needs and functional layouts, through concept and visualisations, to construction documentation.

faqItems.q: Can an apartment design be tailored to a set budget?
faqItems.a: Yes. The budget is one of the core topics we discuss at the first meeting. We select solutions, materials and furnishings so that they match the assumptions of the investment. We also prepare material specifications and help obtain quotes from trusted contractors, which makes it easier to plan the successive stages of the build.

faqItems.q: Do you design both new-build and secondary-market apartments?
faqItems.a: Yes. We design both new-build apartments and secondary-market properties, including flats in townhouses and pre-war German villas that need remodelling or a complete renovation. Every space has different potential, so we always adapt our design solutions to the existing technical possibilities and the residents' needs.

faqItems.q: Does the interior design include documentation for contractors?
faqItems.a: Yes. Alongside the concept design we prepare complete construction documentation that forms the basis for the works. It contains detailed technical drawings, designs for bespoke joinery and all the information contractors need to carry out the work correctly.

faqItems.q: Can I carry out the project in stages?
faqItems.a: Yes. Comprehensive documentation lets you carry out the works in stages, adapting the schedule to your time or the investment budget. Already at the design stage we help plan the order of the individual works and purchases.

faqItems.q: Do you design apartments outside Wrocław?
faqItems.a: Yes. Our studio is based in Wrocław, but we also deliver projects in other cities. Depending on the location, part of the design process can take place remotely, while the most important stages of our cooperation are planned to suit the specific investment.

faqItems.q: Do I need to know what style I want for my apartment?
faqItems.a: No. Many clients begin working with us without a defined vision for the interior. Through our conversations and needs analysis we help set the direction of the design, getting to know your inspirations, way of life and expectations. On that basis we create an interior that is coherent, functional and tailored to you, rather than copying ready-made styles or passing trends.

faqItems.q: How much does an apartment interior design cost?
faqItems.a: We price every project individually, because the scope of work depends on the apartment's floor area, the complexity of the design and the expected scope of the work. Already after the first conversation we can outline an approximate scope of cooperation and prepare an initial quote.

houses.seoHeading:
House interior design —
Wrocław and all of Poland
houses.seoText: Designing a house calls for looking at the space as a whole. We design the interiors of detached houses, semi-detached houses and residences, taking care over functionality, material coherence and the comfort of everyday use. We work both with houses under construction and with existing buildings due for remodelling or a complete renovation. A comprehensive house interior design covers analysing residents' needs, the functional layout, the concept design, construction documentation and support during the build.

faqItems.q: When is the best time to start a house interior design?
faqItems.a: Ideally as early as the construction stage or right after buying the house. This makes it possible to plan the services, the functional layout and the joinery solutions before the finishing works begin.

faqItems.q: How much does a house interior design cost?
faqItems.a: We price every project individually, because the scope of work depends on the size of the house, the complexity of the investment and the expected scope of the work. Already after the first conversation we can outline an approximate scope of work and prepare an initial quote.

faqItems.q: Can I commission a design for just one floor?
faqItems.a: Yes, although we recommend designing the whole house. This keeps all the spaces functionally and aesthetically coherent and makes it easier to plan the investment.

faqItems.q: What does the construction design for a house interior include?
faqItems.a: The construction design covers the layout of lighting, power sockets and water and drainage points, surface finishes, bathroom and kitchen designs, bespoke joinery designs and all the other studies contractors need to deliver the interior.

faqItems.q: How long does a house interior design take?
faqItems.a: The time depends on the size of the house and the scope of the project. We set the schedule individually before our cooperation begins.

faqItems.q: Do you design house interiors outside Wrocław?
faqItems.a: Yes. We work with clients outside Wrocław too, running projects in different parts of Poland.

faqItems.q: Can a house design be carried out in stages?
faqItems.a: Yes. Comprehensive documentation makes it possible to plan the build in stages while keeping the whole project coherent.

faqItems.q: How much does finishing a house cost?
faqItems.a: The cost of finishing a house interior depends above all on the floor area, the standard of the materials, the number of made-to-measure fittings, the scope of the work and the furnishings you choose. That is why we analyse every investment individually. Already during the first conversation we help estimate an approximate budget for finishing the interior and choose solutions matched to your financial assumptions. A well-prepared design lets you plan your spending consciously and reduce the risk of costly changes during the build.

process.bottomHeading: We manage the process comprehensively from initial assumptions to the final result.
process.bottomText: We spread decisions over time, from general to specific, which allows us to capture all nuances and avoid random choices. We organize the entire process by eliminating doubts and, thanks to our experience, we facilitate decisions. This allows for a calm realization and a result consistent with the assumptions. As part of a comprehensive project, we support you at every stage.

cookies.message: We use cookies for stats and ads.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: The controller of your personal data is kool studio, Zaporoska 83/15, Wrocław, Poland. For any data-related matters, write to hello@koolstudio.pl.
privacy.contactBody: When you write to hello@koolstudio.pl or send a brief via the contact form, we process the data you provide (name, email address, project details) solely to reply and discuss a potential collaboration; after sending a brief you receive an email confirmation. We keep correspondence for as long as the matter requires.
privacy.analyticsBody: With your consent we use PostHog (data processed in the EU) to understand how visitors use the site — which projects they view, how they find us, and how they move around the site (session recording: cursor movement and scrolling, never the content of text inputs). Without your consent we measure traffic anonymously only: no cookies and nothing stored on your device.
privacy.adsBody: If we run ad campaigns (e.g. on Instagram), with your consent we may use cookies that measure their effectiveness (e.g. Meta Pixel). Without consent these tools are never loaded.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object to the processing of your data. You can also lodge a complaint with the Polish supervisory authority (UODO).
privacy.cookiesBody: You can change your cookie decision at any time — here or via the "cookies" link at the bottom of the page:
